title: Fertility Choices with Career Risk
abstract: arXiv:2503.02237v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Couples decide whether to have children before knowing the persistent career loss generated by parenthood. After the loss is realized, household resources are renegotiated and individual market earnings partly determine outside options. This limited-commitment friction places a disproportionate share of female earnings risk on the wife even when expected household resources are unchanged. We embed this mechanism in a generalized-Nash fertility bargain. The model has a unique positive agreement whenever both spouses have positive marginal gains at zero fertility. A larger expected child penalty and greater career-loss risk reduce agreed fertility. A higher loading of own earnings into outside options reduces fertility precisely when the wife's participation margin dominates the husband's corresponding gain. translated_title: 职业风险下的生育选择
translated_abstract: 摘要：夫妻在决定是否生育时，尚不清楚为人父母所带来的持续性职业损失。当这种损失成为现实后，家庭资源会被重新协商，个人市场收入在一定程度上决定了外部选择。这种有限承诺的摩擦使得女性收入风险不成比例地由妻子承担，即使预期家庭资源不变。我们将这一机制嵌入一个广义纳什生育谈判模型中。当双方配偶在零生育时的边际收益均为正时，该模型存在唯一正向协议。更大的预期子女惩罚和更高的职业损失风险会降低协商后的生育意愿。当妻子的参与边际收益超过丈夫的相应收益时，自身收入在外部选择中的更高权重会精确地降低生育率。对职业损失意外部分的保险可以在不补贴其均值的情况下提高生育率，而惯例则不然。
tldr: 本文提出一个广义纳什生育谈判模型，揭示有限承诺摩擦导致女性承担不成比例的职业风险，从而降低生育意愿，且针对意外职业损失的保险能有效提升生育率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized Nash fertility bargaining model showing that limited-commitment friction places disproportionate career risk on wives, reducing fertility, while insurance against unexpected career losses can raise fertility without subsidizing its mean.
